name: Visma eAccounting
description: Visma eAccounting — Nordic cloud bookkeeping: customers, suppliers, customer and supplier invoices, articles, and the account chart. REST API v2, OAuth 2.0.
instructions:
**Setup**
1. Register at **developer.vismaonline.com** and create an application with the redirect URI `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. You receive a client id and client secret.
2. Set `VISMA_CLIENT_ID` and `VISMA_CLIENT_SECRET`, leave `VISMA_REFRESH_TOKEN` empty, and install.
3. Open the connector and click **Authorize with Provider**. Sign in with a Visma user of the customer's company, approve, and you land back on the connector page.

**Scopes**: `ea:api offline_access ea:sales ea:purchase ea:accounting`. `offline_access` is what makes Visma issue a refresh token. If your application has the read-only variants (`ea:sales_readonly`, `ea:purchase_readonly`, `ea:accounting_readonly`), they cover every tool here: change the scopes in the connector's OAuth settings and authorize again.

**Already have a refresh token?** You can paste it into `VISMA_REFRESH_TOKEN` instead of step 3, if you obtained it yourself for the same application with `offline_access`.

**Sandbox and production are different hosts.** This adapter targets production at `eaccountingapi.vismaonline.com`. The sandbox lives at `eaccountingapi-sandbox.vismaonline.com` with its own client registration; a production token there fails in a way that looks like a bad secret. If you want to test first, register a sandbox app and build a custom connector against that host.

**One connector, one company.** The token is bound to the company it was authorised for. A bookkeeper with several clients needs one connector per client.

**Filtering is OData-flavoured** on most collections: `$filter` (operators `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `and`, `or`, `startswith()`, `contains()`; strings in single quotes, dates as full timestamps such as `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`) and `$orderby`. **Paging** uses `$page` (1-based) and `$pagesize` (default 50, max 1000); the response's `Meta` block carries `TotalNumberOfPages` and `TotalNumberOfResults`.

**Vocabulary is Nordic.** `CustomerInvoiceDraft` is an unposted invoice; `CustomerInvoice` is posted and immutable. A draft is not revenue, and an agent summing both will over-report.

**Checked against the published API, not a live company.** Every path exists in Visma's OpenAPI document and answers an unauthenticated request with 401 (not 404); the query options follow the developer docs. The tools have not been run against a real company yet. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

**Cloud reachability**: eaccountingapi.vismaonline.com is public with a valid certificate.

VISMA_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh token
VISMA_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Leave empty: Authorize with Provider fills it in. Paste one only if you already obtained a refresh token for the same app yourself.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_get_company_settings
tools.description: Read the connected company's settings: name, corporate identity number, VAT number, address and base currency. The fastest proof the token works.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their number, name, corporate identity number, address and payment terms.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. IsActive eq true.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer by id, with their addresses, delivery defaults, VAT settings and credit limit.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_customer_invoices
tools.description: List *posted* customer invoices with their number, date, due date, customer, total and remaining amount. Drafts are a separate collection.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_get_customer_invoice
tools.description: Read one posted customer invoice in full: every row with article, quantity, price and VAT, the totals and the remaining amount.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_invoice_drafts
tools.description: List *unposted* customer invoice drafts. A draft is not revenue — keep it out of any figure that reports what was actually invoiced.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices with their supplier, date, due date, total and remaining amount — the payables side.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their number, name, corporate identity number and payment details, for the purchasing side of the ledger.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_articles
tools.description: List articles with their number, name, net and gross price, VAT rate and stock quantity.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. IsActive eq true.

tools.name: visma_eaccounting_list_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts with each account's number, name, type and VAT code, for questions that need the ledger structure.
